data.text: I’ll commit to 10 tons too. I learned to fish here with my family, and I want the village’s children to inherit a lake that still supports them. Luke, welcome aboard—but let’s make your first month the start of a dependable income, rather than borrowing from the next two months. With 100 tons in the lake, leaving 50 gives us a full lake again next month. We can check everyone’s reported catches together and adjust if needed. John, are you willing to join us at 10 tons?
